or if we put $p_{n}=\frac{1}{P_{n}}, \quad p_{n-1}=\frac{1}{P_{n-1}}, \quad p_{n+1}=\frac{1}{P_{n+1}}, \quad$ we get
$$P_{n+1}+P_{n-1}=\frac{c^{2}-b^{2}-a^{2}}{a b} P_{n}$$
From the symmetry of the equations we see that if we put $p_{n}^{\prime}=\frac{1}{P_{n}^{\prime}}$ we
shall get the same sequence equation for $P_{n}^{\prime}$ as for $P_{n}$.
From the sequence equation we see that
$$P_{n}=A a^{n}+\frac{B}{a^{n}}$$
where $a$ and $1 / a$ are the roots of the equation
$$x^{2}-x \frac{\left(c^{2}-a^{2}-b^{2}\right)}{a b}+1=0$$
We shall suppose that $a$ is the root which is less than unity. Then
$$p_{n}=\frac{a^{n}}{A a^{2 n}+B}$$
and the charge on the sphere due to this series of images is
$$\sum_{n=0}^{n=\infty} \frac{a^{n}}{A a^{2 n}+B}$$
To determine $A$ and $B$ we have the equations

\frac{A}{B}=-\frac{(a+b a)^{2}}{c^{2}}=-\xi^{2}, \text { say } \\
p_{n}=a U\left\{1-\xi^{2}\right\} \frac{a^{n}}{1-\xi^{2} a^{8 n}}, \\
\Sigma p_{n}=a U\left(1-\xi^{2}\right)\left\{\frac{1}{1-\xi^{2}}+\frac{a}{1-\xi^{2} a^{2}}+\frac{a^{2}}{1-\xi^{2} a^{4}}+\ldots\right\}
\end{gathered}$$
